note: Provenance record for docs/contract.json. VCF Automation is NOT covered by the vmware/vcf-api-specs (Apache-2.0) repository, so no published machine-readable specification exists for these operations. Every element of the contract was transcribed by hand from the Broadcom xAPIs reference pages listed below.
api_product: VM Apps Org - Provisioning Service (the VCF Automation IaaS API surface in VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1)
fetched_by: seed author, via the Broadcom Developer Portal xAPIs reference renderer

pages.documents: Operation index for the Provisioning Service API. Used to establish the exact set of cloud-account and request-tracker operations, their HTTP methods and their paths.
Get Cloud Account - GET /iaas/api/cloud-accounts/{id}. Source for the apiVersion and $select query parameters and for the CloudAccount 200 response shape.

Update Cloud Account Async - PATCH /iaas/api/cloud-accounts/{id}. Source for the required apiVersion query parameter, the UpdateCloudAccountSpecification request body, the 202 RequestTracker response and the 403/404 ServiceErrorResponse responses.
Run Endpoint Health Check - POST /iaas/api/cloud-accounts/{id}/health-check. Source for the empty request body, the optional periodicHealthCheckId query parameter and the 202 RequestTracker response.
Get Request Trackers - GET /iaas/api/request-tracker. Source for the RequestTrackerResult page wrapper (content, totalElements, numberOfElements).
Get Request Tracker - GET /iaas/api/request-tracker/{id}. Source for the RequestTracker response shape and for the status enum values FINISHED, INPROGRESS and FAILED.

About - GET /iaas/api/about. Source for the yyyy-MM-dd apiVersion convention and for the 2021-07-15 version string this contract pins. This operation is documented here for provenance only; it is deliberately NOT part of the contract's operation set.

UpdateCloudAccountSpecification data structure. Source for the per-field required/optional split, and for the meaning of privateKeyId (access key id or username) versus privateKey (secret access key or password).
CloudAccount data structure. Source for enabledRegions being an array of Region, and for Region carrying externalRegionId and name.
RegionSpecification data structure. Source for the fact that a region entry in an update request carries exactly externalRegionId and name, both required.
ServiceErrorResponse data structure. Source for the error body the mock returns on 4xx.

supporting_pages.documents: VCF PowerCLI 9.1 package manifest. Establishes that the VMware.Sdk.Vcf.* modules (CloudBuilder, Installer, Ops, SddcManager) ship at version 13.5.0.25380678 alongside VCF 9.1, and that no VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Automation module exists - which is why the VCF Automation IaaS surface has to be driven against a hand-derived contract.
